description: This file defines the 'State' class in the Drupal framework, which manages application state using a key-value store. It includes methods for getting, setting, deleting, and resetting state data, as well as handling deprecated states and tracking changes during a request.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Provides a state management system using a key-value store, with support for deprecated states and tracking modifications during a request.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the State object with dependencies for key-value store, cache, and lock backend.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given state key, handling deprecated states.

methods.name: resolveCacheMiss
methods.description: Resolves cache misses by fetching data from the key-value store.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple state values for an array of keys.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a given state key, handling deprecated states and tracking changes.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Sets multiple state values at once.

methods.name: getValuesSetDuringRequest
methods.description: Returns the values set during the current request for a specific key.

methods.name: registerKeySetDuringRequest
methods.description: Tracks a key that was set during the request, recording its previous value.
